title: 超臨界二氧化碳發電循環
subcategoryTitleEn: Power cycles and combined heat and power
summary: 二氧化碳在三十一度、七十四個大氣壓以上進入超臨界狀態，密度接近液體，流動起來卻像氣體。以它作為布雷頓循環的工作流體，壓縮機消耗的功很小，渦輪機可以做得只有蒸汽機組的十幾分之一大，在五百到七百度的熱源下效率可望達到四成五以上。課程定量分析臨界點附近的壓縮功、回熱器的熱負荷、機組的體積流量、緊湊型熱交換器的體積與再壓縮循環的分流比例。
summaryEn: Above 31 degrees and 74 atmospheres carbon dioxide becomes supercritical, as dense as a liquid yet flowing like a gas. As the working fluid of a Brayton cycle its compressor takes little work, its turbine can be a tenth or less the size of a steam set, and with heat at five to seven hundred degrees efficiency may pass 45 percent. The course quantifies compression work near the critical point, heat duty of recuperators, volumetric flow of the machinery, volume of compact heat exchangers and the split fraction of the recompression cycle.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.

nodes: Generator and power or heat network

v30Focus: 用像液體一樣密的氣體推渦輪機：臨界點附近的壓縮功、回熱量、機組尺寸、緊湊熱交換器與分流
v30FocusEn: Driving a turbine with gas as dense as liquid: compression work near the critical point, recuperated heat, machine size, compact exchangers and flow split

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：超臨界二氧化碳發電循環
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Supercritical Carbon Dioxide Power Cycles
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」與「臨界點附近的壓縮功」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling" and "Compression work near the critical point": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling" is correct?
options: 熱機把熱轉成功的比例受熱力學第二定律限制，上限只取決於吸熱與排熱的絕對溫度。
只要機器做得夠精密，熱機效率可以接近百分之百。
壓縮任何氣體所需的功都差不多。
optionsEn: The share of heat a heat engine can turn into work is limited by the second law to a ceiling depending only on the absolute temperatures at which heat is taken in and rejected.
With precise enough machinery, heat-engine efficiency can approach 100%.
Compressing any gas takes about the same work.
quiz.explanation: 熱機把熱轉成功的比例受熱力學第二定律限制，上限只取決於吸熱與排熱的絕對溫度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The share of heat a heat engine can turn into work is limited by the second law to a ceiling depending only on the absolute temperatures at which heat is taken in and rejected. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 熱源溫度與卡諾上限：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」如何決定「超臨界二氧化碳發電循環」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Supercritical Carbon Dioxide Power Cycles”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 熱機把熱轉成功的比例受熱力學第二定律限制，上限只取決於吸熱與排熱的絕對溫度。提高效率因此只有兩條路：提高熱源溫度，或降低排熱溫度。燃氣渦輪的進口溫度已超過 1,500 °C，遠高於葉片合金的熔點，靠的是氣膜冷卻與陶瓷熱障塗層；蒸汽循環則以超臨界參數與多次再熱提高平均吸熱溫度。實際效率與卡諾上限的差距，來自壓縮、膨脹、傳熱與燃燒等不可逆過程。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The share of heat a heat engine can turn into work is limited by the second law to a ceiling depending only on the absolute temperatures at which heat is taken in and rejected. Efficiency therefore improves only by raising source temperature or lowering rejection temperature. Gas-turbine inlet temperatures now exceed 1,500 °C, far above the melting point of blade alloys, thanks to film cooling and ceramic thermal-barrier coatings, while steam cycles raise mean heat-addition temperature with supercritical conditions and reheating. The gap between real efficiency and Carnot comes from irreversibility in compression, expansion, heat transfer and combustion. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：二氧化碳的臨界點為 31.0 °C、7.38 MPa
steps.observationEn: Project file: The critical point of carbon dioxide is 31.0 °C and 7.38 MPa
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要機器做得夠精密，熱機效率可以接近百分之百。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With precise enough machinery, heat-engine efficiency can approach 100%." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：只要機器做得夠精密，熱機效率可以接近百分之百。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 二氧化碳的臨界點為 31.0 °C、7.38 MPa
knowledge.textEn: The critical point of carbon dioxide is 31.0 °C and 7.38 MPa

quiz.question: 依「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」的模型 η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h，以渦輪進口溫度與環境溫度計算的卡諾上限最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h for "Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling", which value is closest to the carnot ceiling from turbine inlet temperature and ambient temperature?
quiz.explanation: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h；代入 Tc = 32 °C、TIT = 700 °C，得 68.6 %（以渦輪進口溫度與環境溫度計算的卡諾上限）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h; with Tc = 32 °C, TIT = 700 °C the result is 68.6 % (carnot ceiling from turbine inlet temperature and ambient temperature). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 熱源溫度與卡諾上限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h；代入 Tc = 32 °C、TIT = 700 °C，得 68.6 %（以渦輪進口溫度與環境溫度計算的卡諾上限）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 TIT 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h; with Tc = 32 °C, TIT = 700 °C the result is 68.6 % (carnot ceiling from turbine inlet temperature and ambient temperature). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise TIT by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：TIT 增加 10% 時，結果變為 70.7 %（+3.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising TIT by 10% changes the result to 70.7 % (+3.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 68.6 %（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 TIT 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 68.6 % (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in TIT with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h；代入 Tc = 32 °C、TIT = 700 °C，得 68.6 %（以渦輪進口溫度與環境溫度計算的卡諾上限）。
knowledge.textEn: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h; with Tc = 32 °C, TIT = 700 °C the result is 68.6 % (carnot ceiling from turbine inlet temperature and ambient temperature).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: TIT 增加 10% 時，結果變為 70.7 %（+3.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising TIT by 10% changes the result to 70.7 % (+3.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
只要應力低於材料強度，高溫零件可以無限期使用。
依 ASME PTC 46 做全廠性能試驗：量測燃料流量與熱值、淨出力與環境條件，修正到合約基準後求得淨效率，並與設計熱平衡比較。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
As long as stress is below material strength, high-temperature parts last indefinitely.

Run an overall plant performance test under ASME PTC 46: measure fuel flow and heating value, net output and ambient conditions, correct to contract reference conditions to obtain net efficiency, and compare with the design heat balance.
quiz.explanation: 依 ASME PTC 46 做全廠性能試驗：量測燃料流量與熱值、淨出力與環境條件，修正到合約基準後求得淨效率，並與設計熱平衡比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run an overall plant performance test under ASME PTC 46: measure fuel flow and heating value, net output and ambient conditions, correct to contract reference conditions to obtain net efficiency, and compare with the design heat balance. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 熱源溫度與卡諾上限：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依 ASME PTC 46 做全廠性能試驗：量測燃料流量與熱值、淨出力與環境條件，修正到合約基準後求得淨效率，並與設計熱平衡比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run an overall plant performance test under ASME PTC 46: measure fuel flow and heating value, net output and ambient conditions, correct to contract reference conditions to obtain net efficiency, and compare with the design heat balance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：性能保證要載明基準環境條件、燃料成分與退化修正曲線，並在大修前後各做一次性能試驗以量化回復量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Performance guarantees should state reference ambient conditions, fuel composition and degradation-correction curves, with a test before and after each major overhaul to quantify recovery.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：壓縮機葉片積垢、渦輪葉尖間隙磨耗與進氣濾網壓降增加，使各部件效率下降，整廠效率每年退化零點幾個百分點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Compressor fouling, turbine tip-clearance wear and rising inlet-filter pressure drop lower component efficiency, degrading plant efficiency by a few tenths of a percentage point each year. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依 ASME PTC 46 做全廠性能試驗：量測燃料流量與熱值、淨出力與環境條件，修正到合約基準後求得淨效率，並與設計熱平衡比較。
knowledge.textEn: Run an overall plant performance test under ASME PTC 46: measure fuel flow and heating value, net output and ambient conditions, correct to contract reference conditions to obtain net efficiency, and compare with the design heat balance.

knowledge.textEn: Performance guarantees should state reference ambient conditions, fuel composition and degradation-correction curves, with a test before and after each major overhaul to quantify recovery.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：ASME PTC 46 電廠整體性能試驗。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: ASME PTC 46 Overall Plant Performance. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 壓縮機葉片積垢、渦輪葉尖間隙磨耗與進氣濾網壓降增加，使各部件效率下降，整廠效率每年退化零點幾個百分點。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
壓縮任何氣體所需的功都差不多。
optionsEn: Compressor fouling, turbine tip-clearance wear and rising inlet-filter pressure drop lower component efficiency, degrading plant efficiency by a few tenths of a percentage point each year.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Compressing any gas takes about the same work.
quiz.explanation: 壓縮機葉片積垢、渦輪葉尖間隙磨耗與進氣濾網壓降增加，使各部件效率下降，整廠效率每年退化零點幾個百分點。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Compressor fouling, turbine tip-clearance wear and rising inlet-filter pressure drop lower component efficiency, degrading plant efficiency by a few tenths of a percentage point each year. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 熱源溫度與卡諾上限：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 壓縮機葉片積垢、渦輪葉尖間隙磨耗與進氣濾網壓降增加，使各部件效率下降，整廠效率每年退化零點幾個百分點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「超臨界二氧化碳發電循環」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Compressor fouling, turbine tip-clearance wear and rising inlet-filter pressure drop lower component efficiency, degrading plant efficiency by a few tenths of a percentage point each year. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Supercritical Carbon Dioxide Power Cycles”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：實際效率與卡諾上限的差距，來自壓縮、膨脹、傳熱與燃燒等不可逆過程。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The gap between real efficiency and Carnot comes from irreversibility in compression, expansion, heat transfer and combustion.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要機器做得夠精密，熱機效率可以接近百分之百。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With precise enough machinery, heat-engine efficiency can approach 100%." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 壓縮機葉片積垢、渦輪葉尖間隙磨耗與進氣濾網壓降增加，使各部件效率下降，整廠效率每年退化零點幾個百分點。
knowledge.textEn: Compressor fouling, turbine tip-clearance wear and rising inlet-filter pressure drop lower component efficiency, degrading plant efficiency by a few tenths of a percentage point each year.

quiz.question: 關於「臨界點附近的壓縮功」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Compression work near the critical point" is correct?
options: 壓縮任何氣體所需的功都差不多。
壓力比越高，任何布雷頓循環的效率都越高。
燃氣渦輪機的壓縮機要吃掉渦輪機一半以上的輸出，因為壓縮氣體很費力。
optionsEn: Compressing any gas takes about the same work.
A higher pressure ratio makes every Brayton cycle more efficient.
The compressor of a gas turbine eats over half the turbine's output, compressing gas being hard work.
quiz.explanation: 燃氣渦輪機的壓縮機要吃掉渦輪機一半以上的輸出，因為壓縮氣體很費力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The compressor of a gas turbine eats over half the turbine's output, compressing gas being hard work. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 臨界點附近的壓縮功：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Compression work near the critical point: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「臨界點附近的壓縮功」如何決定「超臨界二氧化碳發電循環」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Compression work near the critical point” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Supercritical Carbon Dioxide Power Cycles”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 燃氣渦輪機的壓縮機要吃掉渦輪機一半以上的輸出，因為壓縮氣體很費力。超臨界二氧化碳循環的訣竅是把壓縮機的入口安排在剛好高於臨界點的地方：那裡的二氧化碳密度有每立方公尺六百公斤，幾乎像液體一樣難以壓縮——也就是說，把它的壓力提高所需的功很小，近似於壓差除以密度。壓縮機只消耗渦輪機輸出的兩三成，剩下的都是淨輸出。代價是這個狀態點對溫度極為敏感：入口溫度只要高幾度，密度就掉一半。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The compressor of a gas turbine eats over half the turbine's output, compressing gas being hard work. The trick of the supercritical carbon dioxide cycle is to put compressor inlet just above the critical point, where the fluid at six hundred kilograms a cubic metre is almost as incompressible as a liquid, so raising its pressure takes little work, about pressure rise over density. The compressor takes only two or three tenths of turbine output and the rest is net. The price is extreme sensitivity to temperature: a few degrees warmer at inlet and density halves. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：臨界點附近的密度約為每立方公尺 600 kg
steps.observationEn: Project file: Density near the critical point is about 600 kg per cubic metre
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壓縮任何氣體所需的功都差不多。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Compressing any gas takes about the same work." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「臨界點附近的壓縮功」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Compression work near the critical point”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 依「臨界點附近的壓縮功」的模型 w ≈ Δp / ρ，壓力提高 12.5 MPa、入口密度 600 kg/m³ 時每公斤的壓縮功最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model w ≈ Δp / ρ for "Compression work near the critical point", which value is closest to the compression work per kilogram for a 12.5 MPa rise at an inlet density of 600 kg/m³?
options: 20.8 kJ/kg
208 kJ/kg
10.4 kJ/kg
optionsEn: 20.8 kJ/kg
208 kJ/kg
10.4 kJ/kg
quiz.explanation: w ≈ Δp / ρ；代入 dp = 12.5 MPa、ρ = 600 kg/m³，得 20.8 kJ/kg（壓力提高 12.5 MPa、入口密度 600 kg/m³ 時每公斤的壓縮功）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: w ≈ Δp / ρ; with dp = 12.5 MPa, ρ = 600 kg/m³ the result is 20.8 kJ/kg (compression work per kilogram for a 12.5 MPa rise at an inlet density of 600 kg/m³). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 臨界點附近的壓縮功：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Compression work near the critical point: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「臨界點附近的壓縮功」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Compression work near the critical point” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：w ≈ Δp / ρ；代入 dp = 12.5 MPa、ρ = 600 kg/m³，得 20.8 kJ/kg（壓力提高 12.5 MPa、入口密度 600 kg/m³ 時每公斤的壓縮功）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 ρ 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: w ≈ Δp / ρ; with dp = 12.5 MPa, ρ = 600 kg/m³ the result is 20.8 kJ/kg (compression work per kilogram for a 12.5 MPa rise at an inlet density of 600 kg/m³). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise ρ by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：ρ 增加 10% 時，結果變為 18.9 kJ/kg（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising ρ by 10% changes the result to 18.9 kJ/kg (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 20.8 kJ/kg（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 ρ 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 20.8 kJ/kg (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in ρ with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: w ≈ Δp / ρ；代入 dp = 12.5 MPa、ρ = 600 kg/m³，得 20.8 kJ/kg（壓力提高 12.5 MPa、入口密度 600 kg/m³ 時每公斤的壓縮功）。
knowledge.textEn: w ≈ Δp / ρ; with dp = 12.5 MPa, ρ = 600 kg/m³ the result is 20.8 kJ/kg (compression work per kilogram for a 12.5 MPa rise at an inlet density of 600 kg/m³).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: ρ 增加 10% 時，結果變為 18.9 kJ/kg（-9.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising ρ by 10% changes the result to 18.9 kJ/kg (-9.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「臨界點附近的壓縮功」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Compression work near the critical point"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
量測壓縮機入口的溫度、壓力與密度以及軸功率，確認工作點維持在設計的範圍內。
熱交換器的大小只取決於要傳多少熱。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Temperature, pressure and density at compressor inlet and shaft power are measured to confirm the working point stays within design.
Size of a heat exchanger depends only on heat to be passed.
quiz.explanation: 量測壓縮機入口的溫度、壓力與密度以及軸功率，確認工作點維持在設計的範圍內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Temperature, pressure and density at compressor inlet and shaft power are measured to confirm the working point stays within design. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 臨界點附近的壓縮功：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Compression work near the critical point: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「臨界點附近的壓縮功」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Compression work near the critical point” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測壓縮機入口的溫度、壓力與密度以及軸功率，確認工作點維持在設計的範圍內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Temperature, pressure and density at compressor inlet and shaft power are measured to confirm the working point stays within design. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：壓縮機入口要有精確的溫度控制並依場址的冷源條件設計，乾冷地區與濕熱地區的最佳循環不同。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Give compressor inlet precise temperature control designed for the site's heat sink, the best cycle differing between cool dry and hot humid places.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：夏季冷卻水溫升高使壓縮機入口溫度上升幾度，密度驟降，壓縮功大增而循環效率明顯下降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Warmer cooling water in summer raises compressor inlet a few degrees, density drops sharply, compression work soars and cycle efficiency falls noticeably. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測壓縮機入口的溫度、壓力與密度以及軸功率，確認工作點維持在設計的範圍內。
knowledge.textEn: Temperature, pressure and density at compressor inlet and shaft power are measured to confirm the working point stays within design.

knowledge.title: 現場實務

knowledge.textEn: Give compressor inlet precise temperature control designed for the site's heat sink, the best cycle differing between cool dry and hot humid places.

knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：ASME PTC 22 燃氣渦輪機性能試驗。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。

quiz.question: 在「臨界點附近的壓縮功」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Compression work near the critical point" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
壓力比越高，任何布雷頓循環的效率都越高。
夏季冷卻水溫升高使壓縮機入口溫度上升幾度，密度驟降，壓縮功大增而循環效率明顯下降。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
A higher pressure ratio makes every Brayton cycle more efficient.
Warmer cooling water in summer raises compressor inlet a few degrees, density drops sharply, compression work soars and cycle efficiency falls noticeably.
quiz.explanation: 夏季冷卻水溫升高使壓縮機入口溫度上升幾度，密度驟降，壓縮功大增而循環效率明顯下降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Warmer cooling water in summer raises compressor inlet a few degrees, density drops sharply, compression work soars and cycle efficiency falls noticeably. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 臨界點附近的壓縮功：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Compression work near the critical point: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「臨界點附近的壓縮功」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Compression work near the critical point” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 夏季冷卻水溫升高使壓縮機入口溫度上升幾度，密度驟降，壓縮功大增而循環效率明顯下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「超臨界二氧化碳發電循環」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Warmer cooling water in summer raises compressor inlet a few degrees, density drops sharply, compression work soars and cycle efficiency falls noticeably. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Supercritical Carbon Dioxide Power Cycles”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：代價是這個狀態點對溫度極為敏感：入口溫度只要高幾度，密度就掉一半。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The price is extreme sensitivity to temperature: a few degrees warmer at inlet and density halves.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壓縮任何氣體所需的功都差不多。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Compressing any gas takes about the same work." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
